laya_operation.description: Explicit root-scoped Laya action through MCP/HTTP: typed shadow evaluation or candidate label, review, split, export, and delete lifecycle. The server derives canonical task/session identity, validates authorized evidence provenance and current evidence, and owns mode. Capture stores actual runtime outcomes only; per-example consent receipts are not required. Candidate capture and lifecycle mutations use an atomic write. Export revalidates evidence, labels, snapshot, and repository scope; only verified group-safe train rows export.
